camel_example: aliyun ossutil api put-bucket-object-worm-configuration --bucket example-bucket --region cn-hangzhou
description_en: Enables object retention on a bucket and configures the default data retention policy
description_zh: 在Bucket上启用对象保留并配置默认保留策略
name: PutBucketObjectWormConfiguration

fields.help_en: Indicates whether the object-level compliance retention policy is enabled
fields.help_zh: 是否开启对象级别合规保留策略
fields.name: object_worm_enabled

element_fields.help_en: Mode of the bucket object-level retention policy. Valid values: GOVERNANCE (administration mode) and COMPLIANCE (compliance mode)
element_fields.help_zh: Bucket对象级别保留策略模式。合法值:GOVERNANCE（治理模式）和COMPLIANCE（合规模式）
element_fields.name: mode

element_fields.help_en: Number of days for the bucket object-level retention policy (maximum 36 500). Only one of Days or Years can be specified
element_fields.help_zh: Bucket对象级别保留策略天（最大36500），Days和Years只能出现一个
element_fields.name: days

element_fields.help_en: Number of years for the bucket object-level retention policy (maximum 100). Only one of Days or Years can be specified
element_fields.help_zh: Bucket对象级别保留策略年（最大100），Days和Years只能出现一个
element_fields.name: years

fields.help_en: List of object-level compliance retention policies
fields.help_zh: Object级别合规保留策略的列表
fields.name: default_retention

fields.help_en: Container for storing bucket object-level retention policies
fields.help_zh: 保存Bucket对象级别保留策略的容器
fields.name: rule

parameters.help_en: The container that stores the object-level data retention policy
parameters.help_zh: 保存对象级别保留策略的容器
parameters.name: object_worm_configuration
